cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the angry draft of my apology. You may appreciate how much of it I didn't send.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I appreciated the apology. Why bring this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because saying sorry took ten minutes. Keeping the rest from you took all night, and that effort deserves recognition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I want to read what you kept from me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reading isn't approved. Count the pages with it closed. I'd like you to admire my restraint without making me exercise it all over breakfast.

reason: A grants admiration but denies access after B curiosity, seeking recognition for emotional restraint while controlling the risk created by showing the draft.
